blocks.text: Carbohydrates qudrati taur par milne wale organic compounds hain. Lafz “carbohydrate” ka lafzi matlab hai “hydrated carbon” (pani wala carbon). Carbohydrates photosynthesis ki pehli (primary) products ke taur par bante hain. Photosynthesis mein jab CO₂ reduce hoti hai (us mein hydrogen judti hai), to banne wale carbohydrate molecule mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen 1:2:1 ki molar ratio (nisbat) mein hote hain. Is liye in ka empirical formula C(H₂O)ₙ hai, jahan ‘n’ carbon atoms ki tadaad hai.
Classification of carbohydrates (carbohydrates ki qismein)

Carbohydrates ko “saccharides” bhi kehte hain (Latin lafz “saccharum” ka matlab sugar hai), aur isi naam par inhein teen groups mein baanta jata hai: 1. monosaccharides, 2. disaccharides, aur 3. polysaccharides.
1- Monosaccharides

Monosaccharides (simple sugars) sirf ek sugar molecule se bane hote hain. Yeh pani mein aasani se hal ho jate hain. In mein 3 se 7 carbon atoms ho sakte hain, aur carbon atoms ki tadaad ke hisaab se inhein mazeed subgroups mein baanta jata hai. Pentoses (5 carbon) aur hexoses (6 carbon) sab se aam hain aur har jandar mein milte hain. Hexoses energy storage (tawanai jama karne) mein markazi kirdar ada karte hain. Energy jama karne wala sab se bunyadi molecule glucose hai, jis mein energy rakhne wale saat C-H bonds hain. Is ka formula C₆H₁₂O₆ ya (CH₂O)₆ hai.

blocks.text: Isomers of monosaccharides

Jin molecules mein atoms ki tadaad ek jaisi ho (molecular formula ek ho) magar atoms ki tarteeb (arrangement) alag ho (structural formula alag ho), unhein ek doosre ke isomers kehte hain. Maslan sirf glucose ka formula C₆H₁₂O₆ nahin; fructose aur galactose ka molecular formula bhi yehi hai, magar un ke structural formulas alag hain. Structure aur rukh (orientation) ke yeh farq polymers banne mein bohat aham asar rakhte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khuli-zanjeer (Fischer) formulas, unwan Aldose, Ketose, Aldose: glucose (carbon 1 par C=O), fructose (carbon 2 par C=O) aur galactose (carbon 1 par C=O). C=O groups roshan hain, aur glucose aur galactose ke carbon 4 par H aur OH, jo ulte hain, roshan hain. Labels: Aldose, Ketose, Glucose, Fructose, Galactose.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.12: Glucose ke structural aur stereoisomers (kitab ki Figure 4.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Fructose mein double bond wala oxygen zanjeer ke aakhri carbon ki bajaye andar wale carbon (number 2) se jura hai. Yani glucose aur fructose structural isomers hain. Glucose aur galactose mein sirf carbon number 4 par ek hydroxyl (OH) group ka rukh (orientation) alag hai (Figure 4.12). Matlab glucose aur galactose stereoisomers hain.

blocks.alt: Khuli-zanjeer ribose: upar H-C=O, phir H-C-OH ki ikaiyan, aur neeche H (C1 aldehyde se C5 tak).
blocks.caption: Figure 4.13: Ribose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aam paanch carbon wali (pentose) sugars mein ribose aur deoxyribose (jo nucleic acids aur ATP mein milti hain) aur ribulose (jo photosynthesis mein precursor yani shuruati maadda hai) shamil hain.
Ring structures of monosaccharides

Solution (pani) mein zyada tar monosaccharides ring (chhalle) ki shakal ikhtiyar kar lete hain. Ring tab banti hai jab ek hi sugar molecule ke do carbon atoms ke darmiyan oxygen ka pul (oxygen-bridge) ban jaye (Figure 4.14).
Glucose mein oxygen-bridge carbon number 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan banta hai, is liye chhe kone wali ring (pyran) banti hai.
Galactose mein bhi oxygen-bridge carbon number 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan banta hai, aur phir chhe kone wali (pyran) ring banti hai.
Fructose mein oxygen-bridge carbon number 2 aur 5 ke darmiyan banta hai, is liye paanch kone wali ring (furan) banti hai.
Ribose jab solution mein jati hai to oxygen-bridge carbon number 1 aur 4 ke darmiyan banta hai, is liye paanch kone wali ring (furan) banti hai.

D-glucose ki do shaklein hain: alpha-D-glucose aur beta-D-glucose. In mein sirf carbon 1 par OH group ki simt (direction) ka farq hai: α-D-glucose mein OH neeche ki taraf hai aur β-D-glucose mein upar ki taraf. Bohat se alpha-D-glucose molecules jur kar starch naam ka polymer banate hain, aur bohat se beta-D-glucose molecules jur kar cellulose naam ka polymer.

blocks.alt: Haworth rings, carbon numbers aur har H aur OH ke saath: glucose aur galactose (chhe kone wali rings, carbon 6 CH2OH; galactose mein carbon 4 ka OH upar hai), fructose aur ribose (paanch kone wali rings). Neeche: alpha-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH neeche) aur beta-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH upar), roshan.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.14: Glucose, galactose, fructose aur ribose ki ring banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Haworth ring ko aise dekhein jaise ring kaghaz se bahar ko leti hui ho: moti (bold) lakeer aap ki taraf wala kinara hai. Har carbon par ek group upar aur ek neeche hai. Glucose aur galactose mein sirf carbon 4 ka farq hai: glucose mein OH neeche, galactose mein upar. Alpha aur beta glucose mein sirf carbon 1 ka farq hai: alpha mein OH neeche, beta mein upar.

Fischer aur Haworth projections sugar molecules ki structure dikhane ke do tareeqe hain. Fischer projection German chemist Emil Fischer ne 1891 mein banayi; is mein carbohydrate ko ring ki bajaye khuli (open) zanjeer ki shakal mein dikhaya jata hai. Haworth projection British chemist Sir Norman Haworth ke naam par hai; yeh sugars ko un ki ring (cyclic) shakal mein dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: D-glucose (linear form) Fischer projection mein, carbons 1 (CHO) se 6 (CH2OH) tak numbered; do laal teer alpha-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH neeche) aur beta-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH upar) ki Haworth rings ki taraf, har ek par tamam H, OH aur carbon numbers.
blocks.caption: Glucose ki Fischer aur Haworth projections (kitab ka side box) (kitab ke side box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 2. Disaccharides

Disaccharides do monosaccharides se dehydration synthesis (pani nikal kar jurne) ke zariye bante hain. Do monosaccharides ke darmiyan wale covalent bond ko glycosidic bond kehte hain. Hydrolysis par yeh wapas unhi monosaccharides mein toot jate hain jin se bane thay. Monosaccharides ke muqable mein yeh pani mein kam hal hote hain. Jism ke liye (physiologically) aham disaccharides yeh hain:
Maltose (malt sugar)

Maltose do glucose monomers se bana hai. Dono glucose ek glucose ke carbon 1 aur doosre glucose ke carbon 4 ke darmiyan 1,4-glycosidic bond se jure hain. Yeh bohat se anaj (cereals, jaise gandum aur makai) mein milta hai, aur starch ke digestion (hazme) ke dauran darmiyani (intermediate) product ke taur par bhi banta hai (Figure 4.15).

blocks.alt: Do alpha-glucose Haworth rings carbon numbers ke saath; pehli ke carbon 1 ka OH aur doosri ke carbon 4 ka HO roshan hain. Teer neeche, H2O nikalta hai, aur maltose banta hai: rings carbon 1 aur carbon 4 ke darmiyan ek O se juri hain, label 1,4-glycosidic linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.15: Do glucose ke condensation se ek maltose ki dehydration synthesis (kitab ki Figure 4.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle glucose ke carbon 1 ka OH aur doosre glucose ke carbon 4 ke OH ka H mil kar pani (H₂O) ban jate hain. Baqi bacha O dono rings ko jorta hai. Kyunke yeh pul carbon 1 aur carbon 4 ko jorta hai, ise 1,4-glycosidic linkage kehte hain.
Lactose (milk sugar)

Lactose ek glucose aur ek galactose subunit se bana hai, yani galactose 1-4 glucose. Yeh sirf mammals (doodh pilane wale janwaron) ke doodh mein milta hai aur un ke bachon ke liye energy ka bunyadi zariya hai.

blocks.alt: Do Haworth rings carbon numbers ke saath: galactose subunit (carbon 4 ka OH upar) jis ka carbon 1 ek O ke zariye glucose subunit ke carbon 4 se jura hai. Labels: Galactose subunit, Glucose subunit, 1,4-glycosidic linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.16: Lactose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Sucrose (cane sugar)

Sucrose ek glucose aur ek fructose subunit se bana hai, yani glucose 1-2 fructose. Yeh sab se jana pehchana disaccharide hai aur isay table sugar (cheeni) bhi kehte hain. Yeh hamare khane ko meetha karta hai. Is ka sahi molecular formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ hai. Yeh bare podon (higher plants) ki phloem vessels mein bhi milta hai, jahan yeh poday ke mukhtalif hisson tak glucose le jane aur lane ka transport product hai. Isi liye isay transport disaccharide bhi kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne sucrose ka formula C₁₁H₂₂O₁₁ likha hai. Sahi formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ hai: glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆) + fructose (C₆H₁₂O₆) = C₁₂H₂₄O₁₂, aur jurte waqt ek H₂O nikalta hai, is liye C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁.

blocks.alt: Glucose ki ring (chhe kone, carbon numbers 1 se 6) jis ka carbon 1 ek O ke zariye fructose ring (paanch kone, carbon numbers 1 se 6, carbon 1 par HOCH2) ke carbon 2 se jura hai. Labels: Glucose subunit, Fructose subunit, 1,2-glycosidic linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.17: Sucrose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1950 tak khane ke sweeteners (meetha karne wali cheezein) ganne aur chuqandar (beet) se nikali sucrose se liye jate thay. Market ka chhota hissa makai (corn) ke starch ko glucose mein tor kar sweetener banata tha, magar glucose sucrose se aadha meetha hai, is liye yeh tareeqa cheeni ka sanjeeda muqabla na kar saka. 1980s mein makai ke starch se mile glucose ko us ke isomer fructose mein badalne ka tareeqa bana. Fructose sucrose se bhi zyada meetha hai. Is tarah bana high-fructose corn syrup sasta hai aur bohat si tayyar (prepared) khane ki cheezon mein sucrose ki jagah le chuka hai. “Cola” soft drinks banane wale kabhi duniya mein sucrose ke sab se bare commercial istemal karne wale thay; ab unhon ne taqreeban poori tarah sucrose ki jagah high-fructose corn syrup istemal karna shuru kar diya hai.
3. Polysaccharides

Polysaccharides qudrat mein sab se complex aur sab se zyada milne wale carbohydrates hain. Yeh bohat se monosaccharides ki lambi zanjeerein (chains) hain jo glycosidic bonds se jure hote hain. Teen aham polysaccharides yeh hain:
Starch

Starch podon ka storage (jama kiya hua) polysaccharide hai. Yeh pani mein hal nahin hota aur bohat se poday ke cells ke andar starch granules (daane) banata hai. Hal na hone ki wajah se yeh cells ka water potential nahin badalta, is liye cells osmosis se faltu pani nahin khenchte. Starch khalis (pure) maadda nahin, balke amylose aur amylopectin ka mixture hai (Figure 4.18).
Amylose glucose monomers ki zanjeer hai jo 1,4-glycosidic linkages se jure hain. Yeh seedhi aur bina shaakh (unbranched) hai, magar helix (spring jaisi kundli) mein lipat jati hai.

Amylopectin bhi glucose monomers ki zanjeer hai (1,4-glycosidic linkages ke saath), magar is mein shaakhein (branches) bhi hain jo 1,6-glycosidic linkages se bani hain. Is tarah is ke zyada sire (ends) hain, jinhein amylase enzymes zyada tezi se tor sakte hain. Amylose aur amylopectin dono ko enzyme amylase maltose mein torta hai, magar alag alag raftar se.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Both amylase and amylopectin” chhapa hai. Pehla lafz “amylose” hona chahiye: starch ke dono hisse, amylose aur amylopectin, enzyme amylase se maltose mein toot-te hain. Amylase enzyme hai, starch ka hissa nahin.

blocks.alt: (a) Amylose: glucose motiyon ki ek be-shaakh zanjeer jo kundli (helix) mein lipti hai, pehlu se chhallon ki tarah dikhti hai. (b) Amylopectin: glucose motiyon ki zanjeer jis se shaakhein (branches) nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.18: (a) amylose, (b) amylopectin (kitab ki Figure 4.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Glycogen

Glycogen ki structure amylopectin jaisi hai: glucose monomers ki zanjeer (1,4-glycosidic linkages) jis mein shaakhein (1,6-glycosidic linkages) hain. Janwar isay apne storage polysaccharide ke taur par banate hain, aur yeh zyada tar muscles (pathon) aur liver (jigar) mein milta hai. Bohat zyada shaakhon wala hone ki wajah se yeh bohat jaldi glucose mein tora ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose motiyon ki zanjeer jis se bohat si shaakhein nikalti hain, aur kuch shaakhon se aur shaakhein: bohat zyada shaakh-daar molecule.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.19: Glycogen (kitab ki Figure 4.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Cellulose

Cellulose sirf podon mein milta hai, jahan yeh cell walls ka asal hissa hai. Yeh bhi glucose monomers ki zanjeer hai (1,4-glycosidic linkages ke saath), magar glucose ke ek alag isomer se bani hai. Starch aur glycogen mein alpha-glucose hai, jis mein carbon 1 ka OH group ring se neeche ki taraf hota hai; jabke cellulose mein beta-glucose hai, jis mein carbon 1 ka OH upar ki taraf hota hai. Is ka matlab hai ke cellulose mein har doosra glucose molecule ulta (inverted) hota hai (Figure 4.20).

blocks.alt: Chaar glucose rings ki do qataarein, carbon numbers 1 se 6. Starch: tamam rings ek hi rukh, C1-O-C4 se juri; teer O pulon tak, label Alpha 1-4 glycosidic bonds in starch. Cellulose: har doosri ring ulti (carbon 6 neeche), C1-O-C4 se juri; label Beta 1-4 glycosidic bonds in cellulose.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.20: Starch aur cellulose ka farq (kitab ki Figure 4.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar starch mein har glucose ring seedhi hai (alpha glucose, carbon 1 ka OH neeche), is liye zanjeer mur kar kundli banati hai. Neeche cellulose mein beta glucose hai (carbon 1 ka OH upar), is liye jorne ke liye har doosri ring ulti ho jati hai; yeh zanjeer seedhi rehti hai aur aisi zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar mazboot resha banati hain.

Yeh chhota sa farq structure aur properties mein bohat bara farq paida karta hai. Starch ka alpha 1-4 glucose polymer kundli bana kar granules (daane) banata hai. Doosri taraf cellulose ka beta 1-4 glucose polymer seedhi zanjeerein banata hai. Aisi sainkron zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar cellulose microfibrils banati hain, aur yeh microfibrils mil kar cellulose fibrils (resha) banate hain (Figure 4.21). Yeh bohat mazboot aur sakht (rigid) hote hain aur poday ke cells ko, is liye naye podon ko, aur kaghaz aur cotton (kapas) jaisi cheezon ko mazbooti dete hain.

blocks.alt: Poday ka cell apni cell wall ke saath; wall ka bara kiya hissa aar-paar resha dikhata hai; ek cellulose fibril silinder (cylinder) ki tarah jis ke kate sire par microfibrils hain; neeche glucose rings ki mutawazi (parallel) cellulose zanjeerein jo dashed hydrogen bonds se juri hain. Labels: Plant cell, Cell wall, Cellulose fibril, Microfibril, Cellulose chains.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.21: Poday ki cell wall mein cellulose fibrils (kitab ki Figure 4.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Beta-glycosidic bond amylase se nahin toot sakta; is ke liye khaas enzyme cellulase chahiye. Sirf kuch bacteria aur kuch protozoans ke paas cellulase hota hai. Gaay aur deemak (termites) jaise herbivores (ghaas khane wale), jin ki khuraak zyada tar cellulose hai, apni aanton (guts) mein mutualistic bacteria (faida dene aur lene wale bacteria) rakhte hain. Yahi bacteria un ka cellulose hazam karte hain. Insaan cellulose hazam nahin kar sakte; khane mein mojood cellulose ko dietary fibre kehte hain.
Chitin

Chitin cellulose ki badli hui (modified) shakal hai. Yeh kekron (crabs), lobsters aur keeron (insects) ke exoskeletons (bahar wale sakht dhanche) mein milta hai, aur fungi ki cell wall bhi isi se bani hai. Cellulose ki tarah yeh bhi glucose ka polymer hai, aur glucose monomers ke darmiyan jor bhi cellulose jaisa hai. Magar chitin mein har glucose molecule par ek nitrogen wala group laga hota hai (Figure 4.22). Bohat kam jandar isay hazam kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar glucose rings O pulon se juri, cellulose ki tarah har doosri ring ulti; har ring ke carbon 2 par ghere mein nitrogen wala group NH-C(=O)-CH3. Labels: Glucose, Nitrogen-containing group.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.22: Chitin molecule ka ek hissa (kitab ki Figure 4.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Pectin aur lignin: yeh bhi polysaccharides hain jo building material (tameeri maadde) ke taur par kaam aate hain. Yeh poday ke cells ki cell walls mein hote hain.

Agar: yeh red algae (laal kaai) ki cell walls mein milta hai. Isay khane ko gaarha karne (thickener) ke liye istemal kiya jata hai, aur laboratories mein bacteria aur fungi ugane ke medium ke taur par bhi.
Murein: yeh sugar aur peptide se bana polymer hai jo prokaryotes (bacteria) ki cell walls mein milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Starch aur cellulose dono glucose ke 1-4 jure polymers hain. Samjhayein ke ek khuraak ka storage aur doosra tameeri maadda kyun hai, aur hum ek ko hazam kar sakte hain doosre ko kyun nahin.
blocks.explanation: Starch alpha-glucose se bana hai, is liye us ki zanjeerein lipat kar chhote daane (granules) banati hain jo jama karne mein aasan hain, aur amylase inhein maltose mein tor deta hai. Cellulose beta-glucose se bana hai jis mein har doosri unit ulti hai, is liye us ki zanjeerein seedhi rehti hain aur hydrogen bonds se jur kar mazboot microfibrils banati hain; yeh cell walls ke liye behtareen hain. Amylase beta bond nahin kaat sakta; sirf cellulase kaat sakta hai, jo insanon ke paas nahin. Is liye cellulose dietary fibre ban kar guzar jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Carbohydrates, C(H₂O)ₙ, photosynthesis ki primary products hain; teen groups: monosaccharides, disaccharides, polysaccharides.

Monosaccharides mein 3 se 7 carbons (trioses se heptoses); glucose C₆H₁₂O₆ energy ka bunyadi zakheera hai. Glucose, fructose (structural isomer, C=O carbon 2 par) aur galactose (stereoisomer, carbon 4 par OH ulta) ka formula ek hai. Rings: glucose aur galactose pyran (C1-C5), fructose (C2-C5) aur ribose (C1-C4) furan; alpha-glucose se starch, beta-glucose se cellulose.
Disaccharides glycosidic bond se bante hain: maltose (glucose 1-4 glucose), lactose (galactose 1-4 glucose), sucrose (glucose 1-2 fructose, C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁, transport sugar).

Polysaccharides: starch (amylose seedhi kundli, amylopectin shaakhdar; amylase se maltose), glycogen (bohat shaakhdar, janwaron ka storage), cellulose (beta 1-4, seedhi zanjeerein, microfibrils; cellulase chahiye), chitin (nitrogen group wala cellulose); pectin, lignin, agar aur murein bhi.
